Rebeltrack Example

Source: vignettes/rebeltrack_example.Rmd
rebeltrack_example.Rmd

Load packages

library(tidyverse)
library(rebeltrack)

Load Dataset

dataset <- rebeltrack_load_dataset(type = UCDP_STATE_BASED, region = "Africa")

Create RebelTrack DataFrame

data <- rebeltrack_dataframe(dataset,
                             side = SIDE_B,
                             period = "month",
                             balanced = TRUE)
data
## An object of class "RebelTrackDataFrame"
## Slot "data":
## # A tibble: 50,112 x 4
##    actor period_start period_end active
##    <int> <date>       <date>     <lgl> 
##  1    84 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE 
##  2    97 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE 
##  3    98 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE 
##  4   112 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE 
##  5   234 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE 
##  6   341 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE 
##  7   413 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE 
##  8   414 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 TRUE  
##  9   416 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE 
## 10   422 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE 
## # ... with 50,102 more rows

Generate Variables

Using %>% Pipes

data <- data %>% 
  rebeltrack_event_count(event_count) %>% 
  rebeltrack_days_affected(days_affected) %>% 
  rebeltrack_casualty_count(SIDE_A, casualties_A) %>% 
  rebeltrack_casualty_count(SIDE_B, casualties_B)
  
data
## An object of class "RebelTrackDataFrame"
## Slot "data":
## # A tibble: 50,112 x 8
##    actor period_start period_end active event_count days_affected
##    <int> <date>       <date>     <lgl>        <dbl>         <dbl>
##  1    84 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE           NA            NA
##  2    97 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE           NA            NA
##  3    98 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE           NA            NA
##  4   112 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE           NA            NA
##  5   234 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE           NA            NA
##  6   341 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE           NA            NA
##  7   413 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE           NA            NA
##  8   414 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 TRUE             1             1
##  9   416 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE           NA            NA
## 10   422 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE           NA            NA
## # ... with 50,102 more rows, and 2 more variables: casualties_A <dbl>,
## #   casualties_B <dbl>

Without %>% Pipes

data <- rebeltrack_dataframe(dataset,
                             side = SIDE_B,
                             period = "month",
                             balanced = TRUE)

data <- rebeltrack_event_count(data, event_count) 
data <- rebeltrack_days_affected(data, days_affected)
data <- rebeltrack_casualty_count(data, SIDE_A, casualties_A) 
data <- rebeltrack_casualty_count(data, SIDE_B, casualties_B) 

data
